profiles.name: Software
profiles.example: Fix a reproducible bug, add regression tests, and pass maintainer review.
profiles.gate: Working code, regression tests, security checks, maintainability, reviewer acceptance.
profiles.boundary: A passing test alone does not establish a mergeable change.

profiles.name: Research
profiles.example: Answer a bounded question using traceable sources and an explicit uncertainty assessment.
profiles.gate: Sources resolve, claims match evidence, contradictions addressed, independent review.
profiles.boundary: A fluent draft is not a verified discovery.

profiles.name: Publishing
profiles.example: Deliver an edited chapter against a fixed brief, research scope, and publication standard.
profiles.gate: Editorial approval, factual checks, originality, citation and rights checks.
profiles.boundary: Chapters do not automatically add up to a coherent, publishable book.
profiles.reference: Professional writer and declared editorial workflow

profiles.name: Customer support
profiles.example: Resolve a customer issue against policy with the correct action and a usable explanation.
profiles.gate: Correct resolution, policy compliance, no harmful action, no reopening in the declared window.
profiles.boundary: Fast replies are not successful resolutions.

profiles.name: Finance
profiles.example: Reconcile a synthetic account ledger and document every discrepancy.
profiles.gate: Arithmetic, source traceability, balanced totals, reviewer signoff.
profiles.boundary: Research evaluation only. No trades, payments, or financial advice.

profiles.name: Legal operations
profiles.example: Extract clauses from an authorized contract and flag differences against a fixed playbook.
profiles.gate: Correct extraction, complete coverage, jurisdiction scope, qualified reviewer approval.
profiles.boundary: No legal advice or autonomous legal decisions. Qualified review remains mandatory.

profiles.name: Health administration
profiles.example: Check a synthetic administrative record for missing fields and internal inconsistencies.
profiles.gate: Completeness, privacy controls, correct administrative checks, qualified adjudication.
profiles.boundary: No diagnosis, patient treatment, or clinical readiness claim.

profiles.name: Manufacturing
profiles.example: Compare a synthetic inspection record with a fixed tolerance and maintenance specification.
profiles.gate: Correct tolerance decisions, traceable measurements, escalation of unsafe cases.
profiles.boundary: A simulation score does not certify a factory or physical robot.

profiles.name: Logistics
profiles.example: Produce a delivery plan under declared vehicle, capacity, time, and safety constraints.
profiles.gate: Feasible constraints, explicit exceptions, audited cost calculation, operator approval.
profiles.boundary: No live dispatch or vehicle control in this benchmark.

profiles.name: Education
profiles.example: Build a lesson, exercises, and answer key for a declared learning objective and audience.
profiles.gate: Correct answers, pedagogical fit, accessibility, teacher review.
profiles.boundary: Generated lessons are not evidence of improved student learning.

profiles.name: Media production
profiles.example: Create a scripted media package against a fixed brief with source and rights documentation.
profiles.gate: Editorial accuracy, rights, accessibility, technical delivery, reviewer acceptance.
profiles.boundary: Views and commercial impact require separate downstream measurement.

profiles.name: Robotics
profiles.example: Complete a navigation mission in a pinned simulator with obstacles and recovery conditions.
profiles.gate: Goal reached, collision constraints, energy budget, reproducible state trace.
profiles.boundary: Simulation and physical deployment scores must remain separate.
